author: Akihiro-Tabuchi
title: Debian Packages job fails - apt-get cannot reach azure.archive.ubuntu.com (connection timeout)
signature: Could not connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com connection timed out|Network
key_errors: E: Failed to fetch http://azure.archive.ubuntu.com/ubuntu/pool/main/b/build-essential/build-essential_12.10ubuntu1_amd64.deb  Could not connect to azure.archive.ubuntu.com:80 (52.250.76.244), connection timed out
E: Unable to fetch some archives, maybe run apt-get update or try with --fix-missing?
root_cause: The apt-get install step timed out trying to reach azure.archive.ubuntu.com. This is a transient network infrastructure failure on the Azure package mirror, unrelated to PR changes.
reproduction_steps: N/A - transient network failure, not reproducible on demand.
recommended_actions: Re-run the failed Debian Packages job or re-queue the PR once the azure mirror is accessible.
prevention_strategies: Add apt-get retry logic or fallback mirrors in the Debian Packages workflow.
historical_context: This is the 9th recorded occurrence of this pattern. It has been recurring frequently on 2026-08-19.
